issues.issue: Must the s.38(1)(c) excessive-demand assessment weigh the family's ability and willingness to pay through an individualized Hilewitz assessment, including for skilled worker applicants?
issues.applicant_position: Minister's counsel's argument is not set out; the officer did not weigh the family's ability and willingness to pay (para 2).
issues.respondent_position: Individualized assessment under Hilewitz is required, including for skilled worker applicants (para 6).
issues.result_quote: there is, in our respectful view, no reason to exclude that applicant on that basis.
